comparison.objective: Commission a shock absorber versus clip an electrical lead flush while retaining the offcut.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses fine rotary tool work and iterative force-response adjustment; record coordinates cutter placement and closure with offcut capture by the other hand.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two repeatable safe impacts and a locked collar; record requires a flush cut, retained offcut, and no damage to the board or adjacent parts.
comparison.reason: Cutting with fragment retention tests a different ability from adjustment and dynamic commissioning. Candidate response and drift thresholds are not fully quantified.
